question: how to remove professional tags from pictures in photoshop
answer: To remove professional tags from pictures in Photoshop, first, select the Lasso tool from the toolbar on the left side of the screen. Next, click near the edge of the tag. Drag the tool until you've created a rough outline around the tag, making sure to leave a thin border around it. This action helps Photoshop to better blend the background after you remove the tag. Then, use the Content-Aware Patch tool to heal away the selected portion of the image. The tool will automatically define a region based on your selection and remove the tag.
